title: Experimental Economics Smoke Example
description: A review fixture for outcome-constrained token and implementation-latency evidence.

methodology.retryPolicy: No automatic suite-level retries; failed work remains in resource numerators.

suitableWorkloads: Repeated coding-agent tasks with a stable independent evaluator.
requiredEvidence: Declared benchmark target, run-plan weight, complete token coverage, and implementation wall time.
hiddenWork: Provider-side processing that is not observable through the conformed adapter.
gamingRisks: Reducing reported tokens by moving work outside the observable implementation boundary.

changelog: Initial experimental economics fixture without cost telemetry.
acceptanceCriteria: Each target has ten planned simple-newsletter runs and complete selected objective evidence.
governance.contaminationReview: Synthetic fixture reviewed; no hidden production data is present.
governance.rewardHackingReview: Review token-boundary and evaluator-gaming risks before use outside smoke validation.
reviewChecklist: Verify target identity, coverage, accepted-outcome invariant, and failed-work inclusion.
governance.deprecationPolicy: Change the suite version whenever the efficiency methodology changes.
